info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Boulange Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Boulange Produce Detail Catalog API facilitates the addition of new produce details to the Boulange catalog. This API endpoint enables businesses to maintain an up-to-date inventory of produce items, ensuring accurate representation and availability for consumers. It is especially useful for retailers and suppliers seeking to streamline their catalog management processes. Users can efficiently submit product details, enhancing the overall shopping experience for customers by providing comprehensive information on each item.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and store details for various boulangerie produce items. Provide the necessary information in the request body to initiate the creation process.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating details of boulangerie produce. This should include all necessary fields to accurately represent the produce details.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the processed details.
